duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.description: Groups with the same email, phone, or web domain (also normalized name or address; includes archived leads). Choose which lead to keep and archive to compare them; merging only fills empty fields on the retained lead.

duplicates.summary: {groups, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}} · {leads} leads · {scanned} scanned (including archived)
duplicates.archiveHint: Mark as the source to archive / merge from
duplicates.noFields: No empty fields would be filled; the source would only be archived.
duplicates.fieldsFilled: {count, plural, one {# empty field would be filled} other {# empty fields would be filled}} (existing values are never overwritten).
duplicates.readOnly: Read only: you cannot merge or archive.
duplicates.choosePair: Choose one lead to keep and another to archive / merge.
duplicates.mergeDescription: “{keep}” will be retained. “{archive}” will be archived. Only empty fields on the retained lead will be filled{fields}. Existing values are never overwritten.
duplicates.archiveDescription: “{name}” will be archived in Notion (not deleted). No fields will be copied to the other lead.
duplicates.mergeEmptySuccess: Merged: no empty fields to fill; source archived
duplicates.mergeSuccess: Merged: {count, plural, one {# field filled} other {# fields filled}}
